verdict.rationale: Clara's docs show card creation via API: virtual cards are active immediately with no activation step, and cards can be created, updated, locked and deleted. A provisioning guide adds time, day-of-week and merchant-category restrictions plus trip-based auto-deletion. However, the evidence never explicitly covers issuing physical cards or setting a per-card spend amount limit; the documented restrictions are time- and merchant-based, not amount-based. missing for 10: explicit physical card issuance, explicit per-card spend limit configuration, dashboard-based (non-API) issuance flow for founders, independent corroboration of minutes-level issuance.
